name: io.github.voronkovd/pocket-master-mcp
title: Sonicake Pocket Master
description: Control a Sonicake Pocket Master guitar processor over USB MIDI: amps, effects, parameters and presets.

environmentVariables.name: PM_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Substring of the MIDI port name (default: auto-detect)

environmentVariables.name: PM_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where backups, tone files, language packs and logs are stored (default ~/.pocket-master-mcp)
